editorial:
Imagine being plucked from a prison cell and told you can earn your freedom by becoming a super soldier. That is exactly what happens to a group of criminals in this intense ride. You follow these men as they are sent to a secret island called Silmido for brutal training. Their only goal is to sneak into North Korea and take out the leader. The vibe starts as a tough military bootcamp movie, but it quickly turns into a heartbreaking story about betrayal and anger. You really feel for these guys as they realize they are just pawns in a dangerous political game.

What really hits home is the acting and the raw emotion as the soldiers realize their mission is never actually happening. The action is gritty and feels real, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle. If you like stories about underdogs fighting against a corrupt system, you will love this. For the best experience, try to find it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the island scenery clearly, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. Adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is also a great move if you enjoy historical war dramas.
endingExplained: After years of waiting, the soldiers find out the government has no intention of letting them go. They decide to revolt and fight their way off the island. They make it to Seoul and storm the city in a desperate attempt to be heard. In the end, the military surrounds them and kills almost everyone. It is a sad ending that shows how the government tried to erase their existence to hide the secret project.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves military thrillers and stories about government conspiracies.
